summary.en: Traverse values, compute statistics and shift elements without losing data.
summary.bn: মান পড়া, হিসাব করা, উল্টানো ও সরানোর সময় কোন দিকে লুপ চলবে তা ঠিক করো।

notes: The algorithms need no VLA support; fixed capacity and C99 loop declarations work in C17.

sections.title: An array has storage and a used portion
Use one loop for one traversal
Shift in the direction that preserves unread values
Count the work of each operation
Check the used range before reading

examples.title: Read marks and calculate statistics
examples.explanationHtml: Four marks total 290, averaging 72.50. Starting min and max from the first mark avoids a misleading zero minimum.

examples.title: Reverse in place
examples.explanationHtml: Two swaps reverse five elements. The central 5 stays in place and no second array is needed.

examples.title: Insert into spare capacity
examples.explanationHtml: The rightward shifts start at the unused slot, preserving 40 and 50. Inserting 30 increases the logical length to five.

examples.title: Delete an indexed element
examples.explanationHtml: The 30 and 40 move left. A duplicate 40 remains outside the logical range, so the print loop ignores it.

examples.title: Count a bounded frequency domain
examples.explanationHtml: Zero appears twice, two appears three times and four appears once. Every value fits the table indices 0 through 4.

examples.title: Find the second distinct largest
examples.explanationHtml: The repeated maximum 9 does not become its own runner-up. The helper returns 7 and a success flag.

practice.title: Insert with a capacity check
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0 to 9 and n ints from -100 to 100, then position from 0 to n and a new value in the same range. Capacity is 10. Print Count and values: then Position and value: before the extra input, then the new array.
hints: Move backward so an unread source value is not overwritten.

practice.title: Delete the first occurrence
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0 to 20 and n ints from -100 to 100, then a key in the same range. Print Count and values: then Key: before the key. Remove its first occurrence if present, then print the remaining values on one line.
hints: Stop the search at the first equal value.

practice.title: Runner-up without duplicates
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 1 to 20 and n ints from -100 to 100. Print Count and values: then the second distinct largest value, or No second value when fewer than two distinct values exist.
hints: Keep a found flag instead of inventing a numeric sentinel.

practice.title: Most frequent digit value
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0 to 20 and n integers from 0 to 9. Print Count and values: then the most frequent value and its count. Break ties toward the smaller value; empty input prints Empty.
hints: Scan the frequency table upward and replace the best only for a greater count.

practice.title: Reverse and report a sum
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0 to 20 and n ints from -100 to 100. Print Count and values:, then the reversed values on one line and Sum = N on the next.
hints: The sum is unchanged by swapping positions.

quiz.prompt: What distinguishes logical length from capacity?
options: Length counts used elements; capacity counts reserved slots
Length is always the final index
Capacity must change after every deletion
quiz.explanation: A partially filled fixed array keeps capacity while insertion and deletion change its used range.

quiz.prompt: Which direction safely shifts elements for insertion at an internal position?
options: From the position forward to the old end
From the old end backward toward the position
Only swapping the first and last
quiz.explanation: Backward copying preserves each unread source before the destination overwrites it.

quiz.prompt: A backward shift inserts 20 at index one. Which used list is printed?
quiz.explanation: The suffix is copied backward into spare capacity before twenty is stored.

quiz.prompt: Which direction shifts the suffix after deleting one element?
quiz.explanation: Each successor fills the preceding position, and the logical length decreases.

quiz.prompt: Why initialize a nonempty-list maximum from an actual element?
options: It changes the list into sorted order
quiz.explanation: A zero sentinel would beat all legitimate negative values even when zero never occurs.

quiz.prompt: Deletion removes index zero and shortens the range. Which values remain?
quiz.explanation: Six and nine move left and the logical range now has two entries.

quiz.prompt: For 9, 9, 7, 4, what does second distinct largest mean?
quiz.explanation: Distinct ranking excludes values equal to the maximum.

quiz.prompt: What should an all-equal list produce in the runner-up task?
quiz.explanation: There is no second distinct value, so the success flag remains false.

quiz.prompt: A frequency table counts three repeated twos. Which counter is displayed?
quiz.explanation: Each occurrence increments the counter indexed by its value, giving three for value two.

quiz.prompt: What must be true before using a data value as a frequency-array index?
options: The input array has at least two elements
The value is the most frequent
The value fits the counter array domain
quiz.explanation: A domain check protects the counter array from negative or excessive indices.

quiz.prompt: Which array statistic requires a nonempty range in this lesson?
options: Number of occurrences of a key
quiz.explanation: An average divides by the number of elements, which cannot be zero.

quiz.prompt: How many swaps reverse a five-element array using inward endpoints?
quiz.explanation: Two endpoint pairs are exchanged; the center element needs no swap.

quiz.prompt: What is the worst-case movement cost of inserting near the front of n used elements?
quiz.explanation: The suffix may contain almost every used element, with one shift per element.

keyPoints.en: The logical length can be smaller than the array capacity.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যারের ধারণক্ষমতার চেয়ে ব্যবহৃত দৈর্ঘ্য ছোট হতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: Initialize extrema from a real element when the array is nonempty.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যারে খালি না হলে আসল একটি উপাদান দিয়ে সর্বোচ্চ ও সর্বনিম্ন শুরু করো।

keyPoints.en: Insertion shifts the suffix right, starting from its far end.
keyPoints.bn: মাঝখানে ঢোকাতে শেষ দিক থেকে পরের মানগুলো ডানে সরাতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Deletion shifts following elements left and reduces the length.
keyPoints.bn: মুছলে পরের উপাদানগুলো বামে আসে এবং দৈর্ঘ্য কমে।

keyPoints.en: A frequency table requires a known, bounded value domain.
keyPoints.bn: ফ্রিকোয়েন্সি টেবিলে মানের সীমা আগে থেকে জানা থাকতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: The second distinct largest value must differ from the maximum.
keyPoints.bn: দ্বিতীয় ভিন্ন সর্বোচ্চ মানটি সর্বোচ্চ মানের সমান হতে পারবে না।

examQuestions.question: Explain why insertion shifts backward while deletion shifts forward in an ordered fixed-capacity list.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Insertion first requires spare capacity. Copying from the far end backward preserves unread source values while opening a slot. Deletion copies each successor left to fill the gap. Increase length only after insertion; decrease it after deletion. Capacity remains unchanged.

#include <stdio.h>



int main(void)
{
    int a[4] = {10, 30, 40};
    int n = 3;
    for (int i = n; i > 1; i--) {
        a[i] = a[i - 1];
    }
    a[1] = 20;
    n++;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        printf("%s%d", i == 0 ? "" : " ", a[i]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    return 0;
}

10 20 30 40

The suffix is copied backward into spare capacity before twenty is stored.

examQuestions.question: Read n from 0 to 20 and n ints from -100 to 100. Print Count and values:, then the reversed values on one line and Sum = N on the next.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>



int main(void)
{
    int n;
    int values[20];
    puts("Count and values:");
    if (scanf("%d", &n) != 1 || n < 0 || n > 20) {
        return 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (scanf("%d", &values[i]) != 1 || values[i] < -100 || values[i] > 100) {
            return 1;
        }
    }

    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        sum += values[i];
    }
    for (int left = 0, right = n - 1; left < right; left++, right--) {
        int temporary = values[left];
        values[left] = values[right];
        values[right] = temporary;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        printf("%s%d", i == 0 ? "" : " ", values[i]);
    }
    putchar('\n');
    printf("Sum = %d\n", sum);
    return 0;
}

The sum is unchanged by swapping positions.

For input 0, the program prints:

Count and values:

Sum = 0

examQuestions.question: What is the worst-case movement cost of inserting near the front of n used elements? Choose and justify: O(1) always; O(n); O(log n); O(n squared) necessarily.
examQuestions.answerHtml: O(n). The suffix may contain almost every used element, with one shift per element.
